"""Cache and validation semantics."""
import json, subprocess, sys

PY = [sys.executable, '-B', '-u', '/workspace/submission/main.py']
FAILURES = []


def run(request):
    data = request if isinstance(request, (bytes, str)) else json.dumps(request)
    if isinstance(data, str):
        data = data.encode()
    proc = subprocess.run(PY, input=data, capture_output=True, timeout=180)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stderr.decode()[:3000])
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())


def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILURES.append(name)
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True)[:1200])
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)[:1200])
    else:
        print("pass", name)


def topo():
    return {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 100},
                      {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 100}],
            "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 100}],
            "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}


def settings(**kw):
    base = {"trials": 4, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 11, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0,
            "tau": 0, "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 2}
    base.update(kw)
    return base


def plan(weight=1000, split=False):
    if split:
        ab = [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 500}, {"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 500}]
    else:
        ab = [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": weight}]
    ba = [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}]
    return {"A": {"B": ab}, "B": {"A": ba}}


PATCH = {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 10]], "counters": {
    "low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 10},
    "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 10}, "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 10}}}


def repair_answer(events, **kw):
    out = run({"streams": [{"topology": topo(), "settings": settings(**kw), "events": events}]})
    return out["streams"][0]["events"]


# repeated repair -> hit
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}, {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/repeat miss", out[2]["cache_hit"], False)
check("cache/repeat hit", out[3]["cache_hit"], True)
check("cache/repeat same", out[3]["links"], out[2]["links"])
check("cache/repeat same order", out[3]["order"], out[2]["order"])
check("cache/repeat same counters", out[3]["counters"], out[2]["counters"])
check("cache/repeat keys", sorted(out[3].keys()), ["cache_hit", "counters", "id", "links", "op", "order"])

# counter value change -> miss
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 11}}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/counter change", out[4]["cache_hit"], False)

# counter becomes missing -> miss
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": None}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/counter missing", out[4]["cache_hit"], False)

# counter missing -> zero is a change -> miss
events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {}},
          {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [], "counters": {"low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 0}}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/missing vs zero", out[4]["cache_hit"], False)

# demand change -> miss
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 11]], "counters": {}}, {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/demand change", out[4]["cache_hit"], False)

# route weight split -> miss (identity compares weighted path entries)
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "routes", "label": "q", "paths": plan(split=True)}, {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/route split", out[4]["cache_hit"], False)

# same routes, different label and different bundle order -> hit
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "routes", "label": "other", "paths": {"B": {"A": [{"path": ["B", "A"], "weight": 1000}]},
                                                       "A": {"B": [{"path": ["A", "B"], "weight": 1000}]}}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/route reorder", out[4]["cache_hit"], True)

# routes removed -> miss
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "routes", "label": "q", "paths": None}, {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events)
check("cache/routes null", out[4]["cache_hit"], False)

# seed / trials / epsilon changes -> miss
for name, kw in [("seed", {"seed": 12}), ("trials", {"trials": 5}), ("epsilon", {"epsilon": 1000})]:
    events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}]
    out = repair_answer(events, **kw)
    events2 = events + [{"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
    out2 = repair_answer(events2, **kw)
    check("cache/setting " + name, out2[3]["cache_hit"], False)

# validation settings are not identities
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}, {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events, cutoff=[1, 2], bias=1000, tau=5, gamma=[1, 2])
check("cache/validation settings", out[3]["cache_hit"], True)

# zero slots -> always a miss
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"}, {"op": "repair", "id": "b"}]
out = repair_answer(events, cache_slots=0)
check("cache/zero slots", (out[2]["cache_hit"], out[3]["cache_hit"]), (False, False))

# LRU eviction with one slot
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 12]], "counters": {}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "b"},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "c"}]
out = repair_answer(events, cache_slots=1)
check("cache/lru evict", (out[2]["cache_hit"], out[4]["cache_hit"], out[5]["cache_hit"]), (False, False, True))

# LRU: a hit refreshes the recency
events = [PATCH, {"op": "routes", "label": "p", "paths": plan()}, {"op": "repair", "id": "a"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 12]], "counters": {}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "b"},
          {"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 10]], "counters": {}},
          {"op": "repair", "id": "c"}]
out = repair_answer(events, cache_slots=1)
check("cache/lru refresh", (out[2]["cache_hit"], out[4]["cache_hit"], out[6]["cache_hit"]), (False, False, False))

print("failures:", FAILURES)
sys.exit(1 if FAILURES else 0)
PYEOF
